Vector 3

A carry-forward trainer for tempo work and broken ground. The forefoot shield is a woven carbon-look panel over engineered mesh; the outsole steps down to 6mm multi-directional lugs for wet asphalt and fire road alike. Reflective patent toe cap for low-light miles.

02 — Track pant

Drift Pant

Four-way ripstop with a paper-crisp hand, cut generous through the thigh and tapered to a cinch at the ankle toggle. Piping traces the drive line from hip to hem — the same curve as a rally car's racing stripe, run at speed. Zip security pockets, no flap.

Shell100% nylon ripstop
SeamsLaser‑taped, no stitch
KneeArticulated, gusseted
HemToggle cinch, 4 stops
RiseMid, elastic + drawcord
Onyx / Volt piping

Apex Shield

One continuous lens, no bridge to fog or slip. Matte-black frame with volt trim along the brow line and grippy TPU tips at the temple ends. Vented at the inner corners so the lens clears fast on a climb.

Grid Puffer

Cropped body, drop-tail hem, and a colorblocked yoke so the volt reads from across the platform. 750-fill baffles run horizontal for even loft; the hood cinches down over a storm flap that runs the full length of the zip.
